mapper.select: UPDATE application_ai_screenings SET status = 'PROCESSING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, deadline_at = #{deadline}, trace_id = #{traceId}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{screeningId} AND candidate_profile_id IS NOT NULL AND attempt_count < #{maxAttempts} AND ( status = 'PENDING' OR ( status = 'PROCESSING' AND (deadline_at IS NULL OR deadline_at <= #{now}) ) ) RETURNING id AS screening_id, application_id, candidate_profile_id, threshold_snapshot::TEXT, job_snapshot::TEXT, attempt_count
mapper.update: UPDATE application_ai_screenings SET status = 'COMPLETED', overall_match_score = #{overallMatchScore}, dimension_matches_json = CAST(#{dimensionMatchesJson} AS JSONB), recommendation = #{recommendation}, llm_config_snapshot = CAST(#{snapshotJson} AS JSONB), deadline_at = NULL, failure_reason = NULL, trace_id = #{traceId}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{screeningId} AND attempt_count = #{attemptCount} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE application_ai_screenings SET status = 'FAILED', deadline_at = NULL, failure_reason = #{failureReason}, trace_id = #{traceId}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{screeningId} AND status = 'WAITING_PROFILE'
